# Distance calculation based on RandomForest Proximity or Depth

Distance calculation based on RandomForest Proximity or Depth

## Usage

``` r
distanceRandomForest(
  x,
  y = NULL,
  rfObject,
  method = "Proximity",
  threads = NULL
)

distance_random_forest(
  x,
  y = NULL,
  rfObject,
  method = "Proximity",
  threads = NULL,
  proximity_type = c("original", "oob", "rfgap")
)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  a data.frame

- y:

  a second data.frame

- rfObject:

  `ranger` object

- method:

  distance calculation method, Proximity (Default) or Depth.

- threads:

  number of threads to use. The previous RcppParallel thread setting is
  restored on exit.

- proximity_type:

  type of proximity for `method = "Proximity"`, see
  [`proximity_distance`](https://sipemu.github.io/case-based-reasoning/reference/proximity_distance.md).

## Value

a `dist` or a matrix object with pairwise distance of observations in x
vs y (if not null)

## Examples

``` r
# \donttest{
library(ranger)
# proximity pairwise distances
rf.fit <- ranger(Species ~ ., data = iris, num.trees = 500, write.forest = TRUE)
distance_random_forest(x = iris[, -5], rfObject = rf.fit, method = "Proximity", threads = 1)

# depth distance for train versus test subset
set.seed(1234L)
learn <- sample(1:150, 100)
test <- (1:150)[-learn]
rf.fit <- ranger(Species ~ ., data = iris[learn, ], num.trees = 500, write.forest = TRUE)
distance_random_forest(x = iris[learn, -5], y = iris[test, -5], rfObject = rf.fit, method = "Depth")
```
